user_stories.story: As a maintainer, I want Cyclomatic Complexity to stay strictly bounded under 6 on all functions so that maintenance and context reading costs remain low.
acceptance_criteria: find_cc_nested.py passes all 5 functions with max CC=5.
definition_of_done: Unit tests confirm nothing is broken.
Each targeted function has a CC ≤ 5.
No new imports are added unless required, and no dict dispatch patterns are used.
Try/except blocks across all 3 files are no more than 2 total.
Code is clean, properly formatted, and logic works as before with the new guard clauses and helpers.
acceptance_criteria: find_cc_nested.py reports 0 violations across the 3 scoped files.
uv run ruff check passes on all 3 files.
All existing unit tests pass without regression.

cells.criterion: Code contains isolated helpers and uses guard clauses/match statements to reduce CC to ≤5.
cells.evidence: Review the 5 functions using find_cc_nested.py to ensure the max CC is 5.

draft.summary: Refactor 5 specified functions across agents.py, forecast_store.py, and billing.py to reduce cyclomatic complexity to ≤5 using helper extraction, early returns, and match blocks. Interns are divided per file for concurrency.

subtasks.title: Reduce CC in agents.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _format_advisory_value (CC=10) and _get_fallback_narrative (CC=9) to have CC ≤ 5. Use guard clauses, early returns, match/case for type checks (no dict dispatch or hallucinated helpers). extract _format_advisory_value loops/isinstance blocks to small private helpers (CC ≤ 3).
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for _format_advisory_value and _get_fallback_narrative. ruff check passes.

subtasks.title: Reduce CC in forecast_store.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast (CC=8) and _extract_trigger_labels (CC=7) to have CC ≤ 5 in src2/forecast_store.py. Use early returns, matching on types, and private helpers. Do not replace O(1) lookups.
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast and _extract_trigger_labels. ruff check passes.

subtasks.title: Reduce CC in billing.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor validate_promo_code (CC=6) to have CC ≤ 5 in src2/billing.py. Extract necessary checks with guard clauses.
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for validate_promo_code. ruff check passes.

risks: Possible logic regression due to incorrectly applied guard clauses or early returns.
Risk of missing proper type extraction when replacing isinstance with match/case.
Potential to accidentally increase CC of a helper function above 3.

strategy.how_to_fix: Apply guard clauses for early returns, extract complex iterations into private private helpers (CC≤3), replace `isinstance` branches with `match/case` where applicable, and maintain O(1) dict lookups. Allocate interns per file to ensure disjoint fixes.
